stem: Meher wants to decide whether town A (about $47\,000$ people) plus town B (about $52\,000$ people) is near $100\,000$, before exact addition.

options.text: Call the answer sum only, naming that label instead of comparing rounded values.
Round to about $50\,000+50\,000=100\,000$, so the combined population is near $100\,000$.
Say that the exact sum is what creates the rounded comparison.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Rounded values near $50\,000$ each add to about $100\,000$, which is enough to judge the near-doubling claim before exact addition.

teacher.key_rationale: Approximation compares rounded magnitudes for the near-100000 claim. Naming sum alone substitutes a label. Saying the exact sum creates the estimate reverses the use of approximation.
